how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.aimsbibinagar.edu.in.
Fill the application form and attach self-attested copies of certificates, documents, and coloured passport-size photographs.
Super scribe the envelope with 'Application for the post of Guest Faculty (mention subject)'.
Send the hard copy of the application to The Chairperson, Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Hyderabad Metropolitan Region (HMR), Telangana-508126, India.
Make sure it reaches by 14 November 2026.
important_instructions: Original certificates will be verified before the offer of engagement is issued.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Guest Faculty - Telugu, 1 Guest Faculty - Applied Sociology, 1 Guest Faculty - Statistics.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.aimsbibinagar.edu.in) and send it to The Chairperson, Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Hyderabad Metropolitan Region (HMR), Telangana-508126, India, by by post, to reach by 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 64 years (as on 14 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 1000 Per Class/Hour - Maximum 30 hours during the Academic Session for Guest Faculty - Telugu, Rs. 1000 Per Class/Hour - Maximum 60 hours during the Academic Session for Guest Faculty - Applied Sociology, Rs. 1000 Per Class/Hour - Maximum 100 hours during the Academic Session for Guest Faculty - Statistics.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Postgraduate degree or above in respective discipline with a minimum 3 years of experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.
